product_formula.source: J. S. Milne, Class Field Theory, v4.03, Example 5.4 / Hilbert-symbol product formula
product_formula.statement_used: for a,b in Q^*, product over all places v of (a,b)_v equals 1

odd_prime_formula.source: standard explicit Hilbert-symbol formula over Q_p for odd p (Serre Local Fields convention; independently revalidated against explicit-formula notes)
odd_prime_formula.statement_used: if a=p^alpha u and b=p^beta v with p-adic units u,v, then (a,b)_p=(-1)^(alpha*beta*(p-1)/2)*(u/p)^beta*(v/p)^alpha; in particular (p^m,u)_p=(u/p)^m

equation_generated_norm_symbols.reason: the second Hilbert-symbol entry is a rational square

coordinate_pair_local_sign_flexibility.statement: for every odd prime q>=11 and either sigma in {+1,-1}, there is a full Q_q-local four-square endpoint with singleton q-support on A, odd v_q(A), and Hilbert symbol (A,B)_q=sigma

construction.choose_t_mod_q: choose nonzero t with t!=+/-1, t^2!=-1, and Legendre(2t/q)=sigma
construction.existence_count: each prescribed quadratic-character class has (q-1)/2>=5 elements while the excluded set {+1,-1} union roots(t^2+1) has at most 4 elements
construction.coordinates: A=q^m, B=2t, C=t^2-1 with m positive odd
local_square_checks: A^2+B^2 is a Q_q square since its unit residue is B^2
A^2+C^2 is a Q_q square since its unit residue is C^2
A^2+B^2+C^2 is a Q_q square since its unit residue is (t^2+1)^2

coordinate_pair_local_sign_flexibility.S3_consequence: by edge permutation the same +/- local freedom holds for any coordinate-pair Hilbert symbol

reciprocity_profile_result.reason: Goal4F leaves arbitrary nonforced odd primes available and Goal4G shows their coordinate-pair Hilbert signs are not fixed by the local four-square equations; the p=2 contribution is also not encoded by the 210208 forced-prime parity states
